import subprocess
import sys
import os

def extract_window(start_t, duration, output_dir):
    os.makedirs(output_dir, exist_ok=True)
    cmd = [
        "ffmpeg", "-y",
        "-ss", str(start_t),
        "-i", "/workspace/materials/game.mp4",
        "-t", str(duration),
        "-vf", "fps=1",
        os.path.join(output_dir, "t_%04d.jpg")
    ]
    # To name files with actual timestamps:
    # We can run ffmpeg with start number
    cmd_formatted = [
        "ffmpeg", "-y",
        "-ss", str(start_t),
        "-i", "/workspace/materials/game.mp4",
        "-t", str(duration),
        "-vf", "fps=1",
        "-start_number", str(start_t),
        os.path.join(output_dir, "t_%04d.jpg")
    ]
    subprocess.run(cmd_formatted, stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)
    print(f"Extracted {duration} frames starting at t={start_t} into {output_dir}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    if len(sys.argv) >= 3:
        start_t = int(sys.argv[1])
        dur = int(sys.argv[2])
        out = sys.argv[3] if len(sys.argv) > 3 else f"/root/.gemini/antigravity-cli/scratch/inspect_{start_t}"
